operations.summary: Replace a password with a delivered recovery link
operations.summary_zh: 用收到的找回链接重设密码
operations.description: recovery_context is an opaque server-signed value bound to the token, tenant, scope, challenge, and expiry. The server verifies it before invoking the password reset CAS. Tampered, cross-token, expired, revoked, consumed, and unknown links fail closed. Authorization and API-key headers are ignored.

params.name: Idempotency-Key
params.description: Stable key for this operation and payload. Reusing a key with different input returns account_recovery_idempotency_conflict.

fields.name: recovery_context
fields.description: Opaque signed v1 recovery context. Clients must not parse or generate it.

fields.name: new_password
fields.description: New password; 8 to 1024 printable ASCII characters (no space) with at least two of upper case, lower case, digits and symbols; otherwise password_policy_unmet.

fields.name: confirm_password
fields.description: Must exactly match new_password and is subject to the same password policy.

operations.description: Always returns the same 202 representation for an existing active account, an unknown username or email, an unverified email, a disabled account, or a suspended membership. No response field reports account existence, identity, challenge, token, expiry, channel, or delivery state. Authorization and API-key headers are ignored. JSON is limited to the configured 8 KiB default; duplicate or unknown fields, media type parameters, and trailing values are rejected.

params.name: Idempotency-Key
params.description: Stable key for this operation and payload. Reusing a key with different input returns account_recovery_idempotency_conflict.

fields.name: username
fields.description: The account's username or verified email. The handler trims surrounding whitespace and enforces 1 to 1024 UTF-8 bytes; the value is compared case-insensitively. A username match wins. An email names an account only when it is the address the account's own registration verified with a code and the account still uses it; an email set later, one proved only by SMS or the image CAPTCHA, or one whose account belongs to another tenant than the request host (or, on the platform host, signs in to another scope) sends nothing and gets the same 202. Phone lookup is not part of this contract.
fields.description_zh: 账号的用户名或已验证邮箱，去掉首尾空白后 1–1024 字节，不区分大小写，用户名优先。 邮箱只有是该账号注册时用验证码验证过、且仍在使用的地址才能找回；之后改的邮箱、 只验证了手机或只过了图形码的注册、或不属于当前站点租户的账号都不发邮件，回包相同。 不支持手机号找回。
